name: vscode-arm64-assembly
description: ARM64/AArch64 GNU Assembler support: syntax highlighting, outline, go-to-definition, and register hover docs for all AArch64 registers

textMateRules.comment: ARM64 macro calls (identifiers starting with _) — teal
ARM64 stack pointer (SP / WSP) — cyan-blue, distinct from other GPRs

arm64asm.includePaths.markdownDescription: Additional include search paths for `.include` directives, equivalent to GAS's `-I` flag. Paths can be absolute or relative to the workspace root.

arm64asm.diagnostics.enable.markdownDescription: Report problems (missing commas, unknown symbols, invalid operand forms) as you type. Findings appear in the Problems panel — `F8` / `Shift+F8` jump between them.

arm64asm.diagnostics.delay.markdownDescription: Milliseconds to wait after the last keystroke before re-analysing. Opening and saving a file always analyse immediately. The analysis is line-based regex work, so it stays cheap even on large files — raise this only if you find the squiggles distracting while typing.

arm64asm.diagnostics.syntax.markdownDescription: Missing comma, stray comma after the mnemonic, unbalanced bracket, unterminated string. These genuinely fail to assemble.

arm64asm.diagnostics.operands.markdownDescription: Operand shapes that no encoding of the instruction accepts, such as `mov x3, [x4]` or mixing `X` and `W` widths.

arm64asm.diagnostics.directives.markdownDescription: Directives from another assembler (`dq`, `resb`, `%macro`) and values of the wrong type (`.quad 1.56`, `.byte 300`).

arm64asm.diagnostics.unknownDirective.markdownDescription: A directive absent from the built-in list. Kept at `warning` because the list may be incomplete.

arm64asm.diagnostics.dataTruncation.markdownDescription: A value too wide for its data directive, e.g. `.byte 300`. Matches the assembler, which truncates the value and warns rather than failing.

arm64asm.diagnostics.symbols.markdownDescription: Branches and references to a label, macro, or `.equ` name that nothing defines in this file or its `.include`s. Kept at `warning` because `arm64asm.includePaths` may not be configured.

arm64asm.diagnostics.immediateHash.markdownDescription: A constant written without the `#` prefix, e.g. `add sp, sp, 16`. **The GNU assembler accepts this** — the `#` is optional in AArch64 — so this is a style rule, not a compile error.

arm64asm.diagnostics.vectors.markdownDescription: Vector lane index out of range (`v0.s[9]`) and mismatched arrangements between operands.
